name: Bali Live visual loads with active clock
description: Verifies the primary live visual renders with the clock and interaction commands visible.
steps: Observe the Bali title and live clock
Observe the Song Request and Bali AI command cards
expected: The Bali Live visual is visible, the clock shows a time, and both interaction command cards are present.

name: Cloud AI configuration state is visible
description: Verifies the page exposes a clear cloud connection state while the TikTok integration initializes.
steps: Wait for the cloud connection attempt
Observe the small CLOUD AI status text
expected: A CLOUD AI status is visible and reports connecting, setup, waiting live, connected, retrying, or connection error.

name: Mobile layout keeps commands readable
description: Verifies the live composition remains readable on a portrait mobile viewport.
steps: Open the app on mobile viewport
Observe the title, clock, and equalizer
expected: The title, clock, equalizer, and interaction cards fit the portrait viewport without horizontal overflow.
